integrity: Proof derived via exact integer multilinear Möbius coefficients, an explicit rational generating series, a maximum monomial degree argument and Walsh diagonalization; two exact-arithmetic checkers validate finite instances but do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Linear binary words and one forbidden all-ones run only; exact full zero-frequency distribution and invertibility for the other residue classes not established. No independent historical priority or mathematical audit.
title: Run-factor Möbius rigidity and sharp Walsh gaps for forbidden-one-run words
